summary: Executed full backend pytest and full frontend node test suite, then ran mobile-web UI regression checks for Gates overview, Higgins handoff auto-submit/context persistence, offline Ask retry, recommendation popup dismissal, and offline Report retry flow.

integration_issues.flow: Two unique handoff IDs with identical question text preserve separate issue contexts
integration_issues.issue: Not conclusively validated in browser due virtualized Ask list rendering/history visibility during sequential handoffs; code-level guard and backend/full regression suites pass but this exact E2E assertion still needs targeted instrumentation-friendly check.

integration_issues.flow: Double-tap/rerender duplicate prevention for initial issue question
integration_issues.issue: Rapid tap behavior was exercised, but duplicate-count proof via UI DOM was inconclusive because FlatList only renders visible message subset. Backend suite passed and no obvious duplicate symptom appeared.

action_items: Add a deterministic E2E assertion hook (or visible message counter testID) for Ask handoff dedupe/idempotency verification in web automation.
Optionally add focused frontend unit tests for openHigginsHandoff rapid-tap and unique-ID/unique-context behavior to complement backend/API checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Role wording and truthful action-label dispatcher wiring are consistent with current implementation (Higgins explains/guides, Apollo detects/blocks with confirmed evidence only).
One minor lint warning remains: unused `showToast` variable in frontend/app/file.tsx (non-blocking).

Environment naming drift still exists versus guideline text (`EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` in code/.env instead of `EXPO_BACKEND_URL`); currently functioning but worth standardizing to avoid future config mismatch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% automated suites (357/357) + targeted UI scenarios mostly passing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated in browser: app loads in mobile preview; Gates overview has all 10 cards; Higgins recommendation popup dismisses before navigation; issue-specific Ask from File auto-submits and retains context; offline Ask shows persistent Retry and online retry succeeds without duplicate follow-up; Start an unrelated question clears context; offline Account report shows failure and online Retry succeeds. Full suite rerun passed: backend pytest 305/305 and frontend node tests 357/357.
rca_of_issue: No blocking functional regression reproduced in tested flows. Remaining gap is observability for proving duplicate-prevention semantics strictly via UI DOM in a virtualized message list; behavior likely correct (dedupe guards + idempotent backend path) but requires better deterministic probe points for hard E2E proof.
